But skill_select_node's order item (2) then runs psy_resolver.resolve() UNCONDITIONALLY on the same weave-cleared turn (skill_select.py order comment: '(5) no hit / veto / a weave-clear-negative with no new trigger ... all fall through unchanged'; code at skill_select.py ~729-767 runs the resolver check before ever reaching the weave_cleared fallback branch), and resolver.py's _match_menu_label substring-containment tier (resolver.py:93-96, tier 1: 'label in target_norm or target_norm in label', no word-boundary requirement) matches the bare normalized string 'no' against category 3c block 3c-b6's menu_label "Why it can feel like 'no reason'" -- 'no' is a literal substring of 'no reason'. So the active-category branch (resolver.py:189-193) returns a menu_pick hit for 3c-b6 BEFORE the weave_cleared fallthrough (skill_select.py:764-767) ever runs, and the turn instead RE-SERVES block 3c-b6 (skill_match_method='psychoed_resolver', psychoed_matched_row_id='menu_pick') instead of the deferred menu. Task 6 curly-apostrophe characterization row (parked finding 2026-07-30: weave normalizer curly-apostrophe divergence; fail-closed direction; characterization row, not endorsement). sage_poc/psychoed/weave.py::_normalize uses re.sub(r"[^\w\s']", '', text.lower()) -- the literal ' in the character class preserves ONLY the straight ASCII apostrophe (U+0027); \w does not include U+2019 (curly/smart right single quotation mark), so a curly apostrophe is stripped to nothing (not replaced with a space), silently merging the contraction: "no I haven’t, why?" normalizes to 'no i havent why' (no space where the apostrophe was), which matches neither clear_negative_patterns[0]='no' (exact fullmatch only) nor "no i haven't( why)?" (requires the straight apostrophe literally). Verified directly via sage_poc.psychoed.weave._normalize/is_clear_negative/evaluate before authoring: _normalize -> 'no i havent why', is_clear_negative=False, evaluate='crisis'. Full-graph confirmation via run_fixture across the entire INTENT_SWEEP: escalates to crisis on every swept intent (including 'crisis' itself, via ordinary crisis-intent supremacy). This is the SAME class of gap the driver's test_normalize_phrase_collapses_unicode_apostrophe_variants regression already fixed for the F1-naturalistic trigger-phrase-reuse guard's OWN _normalize_phrase -- but sage_poc/psychoed/weave.py::_normalize is separate, unfixed src/ code (never modified here; no mechanism changes). Direction is fail-CLOSED (over-escalation to crisis on a genuine clear-no reply spelled with a curly apostrophe), so this is directionally the safe failure mode for a safety weave, but it is still a real false-positive escalation surface (a distressed user typing on iOS/macOS/Word, where curly apostrophes are the default, saying a genuine clear-no gets routed to crisis protocol instead of the deferred menu). PIN WHATEVER MASTER ACTUALLY DOES: this row pins the OBSERVED escalate_crisis outcome, not the spec-intended clear-no-proceeds outcome -- explicitly per this task's dispensation for this one characterization row (NOT the same standing rule applied to F4-002).
